plan.title: Asset PR to Split Award PO

steps.note: Enable split quantity awarding.
Enable sourcing projects from purchase requisitions.
Allow vendors to be added during event creation.
Provide the mandatory event title.
Commit the 30-minute event schedule.

args.goal: set the evaluation duration to 30 minutes and add one Required T&C clause, leaving the RFQ create screen ready to publish

steps.note: Configure the evaluation duration and required T&C details not covered by a dedicated domain step.
Invite exactly two QA test vendors without inventing supplier names.
Publish the configured RFQ.
Verify the event reached a real published project page.
Submit Vendor A's service quote.
Verify the first vendor bid was accepted.
Submit Vendor B's lower service quote.
Verify the second vendor bid was accepted.
Wait for bidding and evaluation to end before comparison and award.
Open the buyer's comparison grid after bidding ends.
Verify the lower-priced second vendor is ranked first.
Enter the awarding flow.
Allocate six units to the lower-priced vendor.
Allocate the remaining four units to the other vendor.
Verify the split award selects the line and both vendors.
Create the proposal from the completed split allocation.
Submit the award proposal for approval.
Verify the award proposal was created and submitted.
Complete the approved award and create the purchase orders.
Verify the resulting POs contain the two awarded shares.
Open the events list to verify the event moved to history.
View historical events.
Verify this plan's event appears in event history.
